description: This file defines a Flutter widget 'HomeActivity' that manages the main navigation shell of the app, including a Scaffold with AppBar, Drawer, and dynamic body content based on selected drawer item. It includes UI components like profile header, drawer menu, and fragment navigation.

classes.name: HomeActivity
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that serves as the main navigation container with a Scaffold, AppBar, Drawer, and dynamic body content based on selected menu item.

classes.name: _HomeActivityState
classes.description: State class for HomeActivity managing drawer state, selected index, and UI building logic.

classes.name: _DrawerItem
classes.description: Model class representing individual drawer menu items with icon and label.

methods.name: createState
methods.description: Creates the mutable state for HomeActivity.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes display name and email from widget properties or preferences.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the Scaffold with AppBar, Drawer, and body content.

methods.name: _buildDrawer
methods.description: Constructs the navigation drawer with header and menu items.

methods.name: _buildBody
methods.description: Returns the appropriate fragment widget based on selected drawer index.

methods.name: _onDrawerItemTapped
methods.description: Updates selected index and closes drawer upon menu item tap.
